verdict.rationale: Postman docs show internal workspaces for sharing/versioning APIs, Spec Hub for API design, and an 'Application Inventory' that discovers API dependencies, which together support internal API discovery and collaboration, but none of the evidence explicitly describes a dedicated 'developer portal' or public-facing internal catalog product feature for broader team discovery/consumption. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a branded internal API catalog/portal feature, evidence of portal publishing/consumption workflow, and independent confirmation of its use as a discovery hub.
